deed: איסראייד חילץ מאפגניסטן 167 אנשים בסכנה, בהם שופטות ורוכבות אופניים
title: Sylvan Adams and IsraAID rescued women cyclists, judges and journalists from Afghanistan, out of the hands of the Taliban

trailer.text: Sylvan Adams is an Israeli-Canadian businessman and philanthropist and the son of Holocaust survivors, who at the time of the operation was the owner of the Israeli professional cycling team Israel Start-Up Nation, and IsraAID is an international humanitarian aid organization based in Israel.
At the height of the U.S. pullout from Afghanistan, as the Taliban took over Kabul, a sports journalist asked Adams to pull strings to help extract a group of young women cyclists from the chaos.
IsraAID operatives led a first group of 42 women, girls and family members overland to the border, and the group arrived in the United Arab Emirates on September 6.
A second group of 125 Afghans, including female judges, cyclists and robotics team members, flew from Mazar-i-Sharif to Albania in a plane chartered by Adams.
According to Jewish Insider, the operation extracted 167 Afghan nationals.

glance.label: Recognition
glance.value: The UCI president thanked Adams and IsraAID

paragraphs.text: In August 2021 the United States left Afghanistan, and the Taliban took over Kabul.
During their rule in the late 1990s and early 2000s, the Taliban were notorious for repressive acts against women.
According to Velo, after decades of war cycling was starting to take hold in Afghanistan, and women organized their first race in 2017.
Adams said that the Afghan women's cycling team was frightened, and that in Afghanistan one could be killed for riding a bicycle.
At the time of the operation, Sylvan Adams was the owner of the Israeli professional cycling team Israel Start-Up Nation.
At the height of the U.S. pullout from Afghanistan, a sports journalist reached out to Adams and asked him to pull strings to help extract a group of young women cyclists from the chaos.
According to the Jerusalem Report, the request to Adams was made on behalf of an American friend who had been a coach with the Afghan women's national cycling team.

According to Velo, as the Afghan government collapsed under Taliban pressure, a journalist sent urgent SMS messages to contacts at the Israel Start-Up Nation team and asked for help with the evacuation.
Adams immediately agreed.
He said he had no experience with such a thing, but was given a job and committed himself to completing it.
Adams contacted IsraAID.
According to the Jerusalem Report, the organization's teams have worked in emergency and long-term development settings in more than 50 countries.

In late August 2021, IsraAID CEO Yotam Polizer received three calls: the second from Adams about the cyclists, and the third from an activist in Lesbos who knew a way to secure safe passage out of Afghanistan.
According to Polizer, the organization usually works to assist refugees after they have fled, or at natural disaster sites, and not in extraction from within political crises.
Journalist Danna Harman, who lives between London and Tel Aviv, had written about the Afghan robotics team for The New York Times two years earlier and had stayed in touch with them.
She searched a WhatsApp group for someone who used the Signal app, and that is how her friend, documentary filmmaker Roni Aboulafia of Tel Aviv, was drawn into the operation.

stations.title: The first plan: to fly from Kabul

paragraphs.text: IsraAID engaged Afghan operatives on the ground and originally planned to fly the evacuees from Kabul to Germany.
According to Jewish Insider, someone in the group heard about a German media outlet's flight leaving from Kabul airport, and they tried to get the girls on it.
According to Velo, in the last days of the American evacuation a charter plane paid for by Adams flew to Kabul.
On August 26, 2021, a suicide bombing struck Kabul airport.
According to AFP, the Islamic State group claimed responsibility for it.
According to Jewish Insider, after the bombing Polizer realized an alternative was needed.

stations.title: Overland to the border, and from there to the Emirates

paragraphs.text: Polizer, with the help of his contacts in Greece, created a land route that he hoped would be safe, through Taliban checkpoints to the border.
According to Jewish Insider, half of the people had no passports, and the group enlisted an exiled Afghan diplomat who still had a machine for printing Afghan passports.
Polizer said the rescuers went around the city's alleys to collect people from hiding without arousing suspicion.
IsraAID operatives took the women by ground transport to the border of a neighboring country.
Adams cannot name the country, because IsraAID may use this corridor in the future.
According to NoCamels, the group received permission from the president of Tajikistan, and Israeli aid workers met the girls in the capital, Dushanbe.
According to Adams and the Jerusalem Report, at the border Taliban forces aimed rifles at the escapees' heads.
According to the Jerusalem Report, minutes after a phone call to the president of the neighboring country, the group crossed the border to freedom.
It was permitted to stay there for only 24 hours, and Adams and IsraAID had to find it an onward destination.
In September 2021 IsraAID took part in the evacuation of 42 Afghan women and girls to the United Arab Emirates.
According to Jewish Insider, they arrived in Abu Dhabi on September 6, and by then it was already known that Israelis were organizing rescues.
According to NoCamels, citing David Cooper of CIJA, Tajikistan and the Emirates agreed to admit the group temporarily, on condition that a third country guarantee permanent resettlement.
Adams said the Emirates wanted to be partners specifically because the group was Israeli.
According to NoCamels, this was said to be the first joint rescue mission of Israel and the Emirates, one year after the Abraham Accords.
Polizer said that within days he had a list of another 125 people desperate to leave Afghanistan.
According to the Jerusalem Report, they included female judges, cyclists and robotics team members.
The group also included journalists, TV presenters, human rights activists, relatives of Afghan diplomats, artists, law enforcement officers and scientists.
In the second attempt the group arrived at the border in three buses along the same route, and the Taliban refused to let it cross.
According to Jewish Insider, after they were directed to a safe house, within hours they were surrounded by Taliban fighters who ordered them to leave the area immediately.
When a taxi driver carrying passports was arrested and the passports were confiscated, Mohammad Javid Khan was enlisted to get them back.
Khan said the Taliban accused him of human trafficking, but he convinced them it was his passport and that he had to take the others too.
At a dinner in Manhattan during the UN General Assembly, representatives of a Jewish family foundation with connections to IsraAID were present.
When Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama was asked whether he would allow the group temporary entry, he immediately agreed.
The group flew from Mazar-i-Sharif Airport in northern Afghanistan to Albania, in a plane chartered by Adams.
According to the Jewish Press, the operation took place on October 2, 2021.
Adams said one of the moving moments was meeting the last Jewish family remaining in Afghanistan, which left with this group.
According to IsraAID, the organization coordinated the evacuation of the 125 Afghans via Albania in early October 2021.
In Albania, IsraAID provided for the basic needs of the 125 refugees, as well as of over 1,000 refugees already in the country.
Adams brought the cyclists Israel Start-up Nation jerseys, went on a ride with them and sat with the refugees to hear their escape stories.
Fatima Sarohat, 19, a cyclist from Herat, left behind her parents and siblings.
Romaisa Khatibi, 23, who studied medicine in Herat, does not know what lies ahead for her.

stations.title: Where they go next, and who thanked whom

paragraphs.text: According to IsraAID, the evacuees are expected to be resettled in the long term in countries such as Canada, France and Switzerland.
According to Adams, 38 cyclists were resettled in Switzerland, with visas obtained with the help of the world cycling federation.
According to the Jerusalem Report, Adams worked to have the remaining evacuees received in Canada as refugee claimants.
According to Israel Between the Lines, the evacuees held senior positions in Afghan society, as doctors, judges, artists, journalists, diplomats, scientists and human rights activists.
According to the Jewish Press, many of the evacuated women and girls have served as symbols of female empowerment and leadership.
According to AFP, in a separate operation by Transit Initiatives with the help of an Israeli foundation, 278 people who had been evacuated to Mazar-i-Sharif found safe locations by January 2022.
The UCI president thanked Adams, who presented the project to IsraAID and financed the evacuation, as well as IsraAID and its CEO.
Polizer thanked, among others, a group of women activists from around the world led by Danna Harman, who initiated the operation.
Adams said he was gratified to have helped offer the Afghan women cyclists a chance at a normal, productive and happy life.
He said a group of Israeli Jews had saved Muslims from Afghanistan and brought them in with the aid of another Muslim country.
According to sources cited by Velo, at the time of reporting there were still young cyclists and their families who remained trapped in Afghanistan and had been unable to leave.
According to Jewish Insider, relatives of Mohammad Javid Khan who stayed behind suffered harassment from the new rulers, mainly because of rumors that Israelis had helped in the escape.
Khan said that Israelis and Jews have a bad name in his country.
One of the refugees said he left behind his wife and a 10-day-old baby, because the Taliban were looking for him.

claims.text: לפי NoCamels, מדובר במשימת החילוץ המשותפת הראשונה של ישראל והאמירויות, שנה אחרי הסכמי אברהם.
claims.quote: The joint rescue mission is said to be the first-ever between Israel and the United Arab Emirates just one year after the two countries normalized diplomatic ties in the Abraham Accords.

claims.text: פוליצר סיפר שתוך ימים הייתה בידיו רשימה של עוד 125 אנשים שרצו נואשות לצאת מאפגניסטן.
claims.quote: said Polizer, describing how within days he had a list of another 125 people desperate to leave

claims.text: בין המפונים היו שופטים, רוכבי אופניים מקצועיים, עיתונאים, מגישי טלוויזיה, פעילי זכויות אדם, קרובי דיפלומטים אפגנים, אמנים, אנשי אכיפת חוק ומדענים.
claims.quote: The group of evacuees included judges, professional cyclists, journalists, TV presenters, human rights activists, relatives of Afghan diplomats, artists, law enforcement officers and scientists.

claims.text: בניסיון השני, כשהקבוצה הגיעה בשלושה אוטובוסים לגבול באותו מסלול, הטליבאן סירבו לאפשר להם לחצות.
claims.quote: We thought we had it all figured out and put them on three buses following the same route, but when they arrived at the border this time, the Taliban refused to let them cross.

claims.text: לפי Jewish Insider, אחרי שהוכוונו לבית מסתור ליד קונדוז, הוקפו תוך שעות בלוחמי טליבאן שהורו להם לעזוב את האזור מיד.
claims.quote: but within hours were surrounded by Taliban militants who ordered them to immediately leave the area.

claims.text: כשנהג מונית שהעביר דרכונים נעצר והדרכונים הוחרמו, גויס מוחמד ג'אוויד חאן להחזירם.
claims.quote: but when the taxi driver was arrested and the passports confiscated, Khan was enlisted to get them back.

claims.text: חאן סיפר שהטליבאן האשימו אותו בסחר בבני אדם, אך שכנע אותם שזה הדרכון שלו ושעליו לקחת גם את האחרים.
claims.quote: They accused me of human trafficking, but I convinced them it was my passport and that I needed to take the others too

claims.text: בארוחת ערב במנהטן בניו יורק, בעת עצרת האו"ם, נכחו נציגי קרן משפחתית יהודית בעלת קשרים ל-IsraAID.
claims.quote: Among the guests were representatives of a Jewish family foundation with connections to IsraAID.

claims.text: כשנשאל אם יאפשר כניסה זמנית לקבוצת הפליטים, ראש ממשלת אלבניה אדי רמה הסכים מיד.
claims.quote: Asked if he would allow this group of refugees’ temporary entry into his country, he immediately agreed.

claims.text: אדמס סיפר שאחד הרגעים המרגשים היה המפגש עם המשפחה היהודית האחרונה שנותרה באפגניסטן, שיצאה עם הקבוצה השנייה.
claims.quote: One of the most moving moments, he says, was when he met the last Jewish family living in Afghanistan, which had departed with the second group.

claims.text: ארגון הסיוע ההומניטרי IsraAID תיאם, לדברי הארגון, את פינוי 125 אפגנים פגיעים דרך אלבניה בתחילת אוקטובר 2021.
claims.quote: Humanitarian aid group IsraAID coordinated the evacuation of 125 vulnerable Afghans via Albania earlier this month, the NGO said on Wednesday.

claims.text: בינתיים IsraAID דאג לצרכים הבסיסיים של 125 הפליטים באלבניה, וכן של למעלה מ-1,000 פליטים שכבר שהו במדינה.
claims.quote: In the interim, IsraAID has been working to provide necessities to the 125 refugees in Albania, as well as over 1,000 already in the country.

claims.text: באלבניה אדמס הביא לרוכבות חולצות של קבוצת Israel Start-up Nation, יצא איתן לרכיבה וישב עם הפליטים לשמוע את סיפורי הבריחה.
claims.quote: There, he delivered Team Israel Start-up Nation jerseys to the women cyclists, took them for a bike ride, and sat down with all of the refugees

claims.text: פאטמה סארוהאת, בת 19, רוכבת מהראט, השאירה מאחור את הוריה ואחיה.
claims.quote: I also felt sorrow for Fatima Sarohat, one of the cyclists from Herat. At only 19, she left behind her parents and siblings.

claims.text: רומאיסה ח'טיבי, בת 23, שלמדה רפואה בהראט, לא יודעת מה צפוי לה.
claims.quote: Romaisa Khatibi, 23, who was studying medicine in Herat, is also unsure of her future.

claims.text: לפי IsraAID, המפונים צפויים להיקלט לטווח ארוך במדינות כמו קנדה, צרפת ושווייץ.
claims.quote: The refugees are expected to be resettled in the long term in countries such as Canada, France and Switzerland, IsraAID said.

claims.text: לפי אדמס, 38 רוכבות נקלטו בשווייץ, בוויזות שהושגו בסיוע איגוד האופניים העולמי.
claims.quote: Thirty-eight cyclists were resettled in Switzerland, with visas procured via the help of cycling's governing federation, the UCI, which Adams recruited to this mission.

claims.text: אדמס פועל כדי שיתר המפונים ייקלטו בקנדה כמבקשי מקלט.
claims.quote: Adams is working to arrange for the remainder to be resettled as refugee claimants in Canada.

claims.text: לפי Israel Between the Lines, הפליטים שפונו החזיקו במעמדות בכירים בחברה האפגנית כרופאים, שופטים, אמנים, עיתונאים, דיפלומטים, מדענים ופעילי זכויות אדם.
claims.quote: the group of esteemed refugees, who held powerful positions in Afghan society as doctors, judges, artists, journalists, diplomats, scientists, and human rights activists

claims.text: לפי Jewish Press, רבות מהנשים והנערות שפונו שימשו סמל להעצמה נשית ולמנהיגות.
claims.quote: Many of the women and girls among them have served as symbols of female empowerment and leadership.

claims.text: לפי AFP, במבצע נפרד של ארגון Transit Initiatives, בסיוע קרן ישראלית, 278 אנשים שפונו למזאר-א-שריף מצאו בסוף מקום בטוח ברחבי העולם עד ינואר 2022.
claims.quote: It took four nerve-racking months, but by January the 278 people who had been evacuated to Mazar-i-Sharif found safe locations around the world.

claims.text: פוליצר הודה, בין היתר, לקבוצת פעילות מרחבי העולם בראשות העיתונאית דנה הרמן, שיזמה את המבצע.
claims.quote: the group of strong women activists from around the world led by journalist Danna Harman, who initiated this operation

claims.text: אדמס אמר שהוא מסופק מכך שסייע לשנות את גורל הרוכבות האפגניות ולהציע להן סיכוי לחיים רגילים, פוריים ומאושרים.
claims.quote: I am gratified to have helped change the fate of our group of Afghan women cyclists, and to offer them a chance at a normal, productive, happy life.

claims.text: אדמס אמר שקבוצת ישראלים יהודים הצילה מוסלמים מאפגניסטן והכניסה אותם בסיוע מדינה מוסלמית נוספת.
claims.quote: Here we were – a group of Israeli Jews saving Muslims from Afghanistan and bringing them in with the aid of another Muslim country.

claims.text: לפי Velo, יש עדיין רוכבים צעירים ומשפחותיהם שנותרו כלואים באפגניסטן ולא הצליחו לצאת.
claims.quote: Sources also say there are still young cyclists and their families trapped inside Afghanistan who were unable to get out.

claims.text: קרובי משפחה שנשארו מאחור סובלים מהטרדות של השליטים החדשים, בעיקר בגלל שמועות שישראלים סייעו בבריחה.
claims.quote: relatives left behind now face harassment from the country’s new rulers, particularly because of rumors that their escape was facilitated by Israelis.

claims.text: חאן אמר שלישראלים וליהודים יש שם רע במדינתו.
claims.quote: Israelis and Jews have a bad name in our country,

claims.text: אחד הפליטים תיאר שהשאיר מאחור אישה ותינוק בן 10 ימים, משום שהטליבאן חיפשו אותו.
claims.quote: My heart broke for one man, whose face showed pure pain as he described leaving behind his wife and 10-day-old baby.

claims.text: לפי סילבן אדמס, כפי שדווח ב-Jerusalem Report, 167 אפגנים הוצאו מאפגניסטן במבצעים החשאיים האלה.
claims.quote: To date, Adams reports, 167 Afghans were taken out from Afghanistan in these covert missions.

claims.text: לפי הודעה לעיתונות של איגוד האופניים העולמי (UCI) מיום שני, 165 אפגנים פונו מידי הטליבאן בסיוע קהילת האופניים הבינלאומית.
claims.quote: the UCI sent out a press release confirming the successful evacuation of 165 Afghans who, with the help of many within the international cycling community, were able to escape the clutches of the Taliban.

claims.text: לפי Euronews, איגוד האופניים העולמי (UCI) מסר שסייע בפינוי 165 פליטים מאפגניסטן, בהם רוכבות, עיתונאים ופעילי זכויות אדם.
claims.quote: UCI said it helped in the evacuation of 165 refugees from Afghanistan which included female cyclists, journalists and human rights campaigners

claims.text: לפי Israel Between the Lines, פעילים ישראלים וארגונים יהודיים פינו כ-170 אפגנים לאחר השתלטות הטליבאן.
claims.quote: Israeli activists and Jewish organizations have managed to evacuate about 170 Afghans to support their escape from the recent Taliban takeover.

claims.text: לפי AFP, ארגון IsraAID הישראלי, בסיוע הפילנתרופ הקנדי-ישראלי סילבן אדמס, סייע לכמעט 200 אפגנים בסיכון להגיע למקום בטוח.
claims.quote: Aided by Canadian-Israeli philanthropist Sylvan Adams, the Israeli non-government group IsraAID utilised its experience and connections to help nearly 200 at-risk Afghans reach safe shores.

claims.text: לפי NoCamels, משימת הפינוי הראשונה יזומה ומתואמת על ידי ארגון הסיוע הישראלי IsraAID וארגונים יהודיים נוספים.
claims.quote: daring rescue mission initiated and coordinated by the Israeli humanitarian aid organization IsraAID and other Jewish groups.

claims.text: לפי נשיא ה-UCI דויד לפרטיינט, שווייץ הסכימה לקבל 38 אפגנים מבין המפונים.
claims.quote: UCI president David Lappartient said that Switzerland agreed to accept 38 Afghans among those who were evacuated

claims.text: לפי Euronews, הפליטים שהגיעו לאירופה דרך אלבניה ייקלטו במדינות כמה, ובהן שווייץ (38 איש), קנדה, צרפת, ישראל וארצות הברית.
claims.quote: with 38 being welcomed by the Switzerland government while others will head to Canada, France, Israel and the United States.

claims.text: לפי NoCamels, בספטמבר 2021 מקורות אמרו ל-Times of Israel שישראל אינה מציעה לקלוט פליטים על אדמתה.
claims.quote: sources told The Times of Israel that Israel was not offering to resettle any refugees on Israeli soil.

claims.text: סילבן אדמס הוא איש עסקים ופילנתרופ ישראלי-קנדי ובן לניצולי שואה, שבזמן המבצע היה הבעלים של קבוצת האופניים המקצוענית הישראלית Israel Start-Up Nation, ו-IsraAID הוא ארגון סיוע הומניטרי בינלאומי שמושבו בישראל.
claims.quote: Sylvan Adams has chosen to step back from his day-to-day involvement and will no longer speak on behalf of the team
